28857.d: Vinesweeper is a Farming- and Hunter-based minigame for members only.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: Talk to a tool leprechaun at any farming patch (except at Harmony Island, the Wilderness herb patch, or Trollheim). Proceed through the dialogue, and select the chat option "Winkin's Farm". Next, select the option "Can you take me to Winkin's Farm?", to which the leprechaun responds by saying "Avach nimporto!" which teleports the player to the minigame site. There is a portal north-east of the farmhouse to return to the patch. Summoning familiars and pets cannot be brought into the minigame.

28928.d: A Vorago's arm (furniture) is a boss trophy displayed in a player-owned house by using Vorago's arm on a huge pedestal.

28929.d: Vorkath is an undead blue dragon featured in the Fort Forinthry quest series, first found lying dead beneath the ice of Ungael.
28929.ex: Once a long-dead dragon of awe-inspiring stature; now an existential threat of awe-inspiring stature.

28934.d: Vorki is a boss pet and a miniature version of Vorkath.
28934.ex: Would be a cute baby dragon if it wasn't decaying.

28935.d: Vortex was a non-player character that players could temporarily transmogrify into using the Metamorphosis ability as long as the last spell cast was a water or ice spell (or the spell was set to auto-cast when the last damaging ability was used).

28936.d: The votary space is a piece of scenery involved in a Construction Contracts task where players have to build a votary stand.
28936.ex: You can build a votary stand here.

28937.d: The voting box is found within the clan meeting tent during a private meeting.
28937.ex: Records your feelings on the subject at hand.

28938.d: Votive candles are a piece of scenery that can be found in the chapel of the Abbey of St.

28939.d: Voyage is a music track that is unlocked at the top of Baxtorian Falls.
